config.label: Inline Google service-account key JSON (recommended)
config.description: Inline Google service-account key JSON (recommended). Alternatively set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS to a key file path.

config.label: Path to a Google service-account key file (alternative to PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON)
config.description: Path to a Google service-account key file (alternative to PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON).

config.label: Numeric Play developer account id
config.description: Numeric Play developer account id. Required only for the `users` (permissions) toolset.

config.label: Cloud Storage report-export bucket for the `play_reviews_export` and `play_stats_export` tools — the value from Play Console > Download reports > 'Copy Cloud Storage URI' (pubsite_prod_rev_
config.description: Cloud Storage report-export bucket for the `play_reviews_export` and `play_stats_export` tools — the value from Play Console > Download reports > 'Copy Cloud Storage URI' (pubsite_prod_rev_...). Not the developer account id.

config.label: Path to a credentials JSON used only for the storage/reviews-export client
config.description: Path to a credentials JSON used only for the storage/reviews-export client. The report buckets usually can't be granted to a service account; locally `gcloud auth application-default login` is auto-detected instead.

config.label: Comma-separated toolsets to enable, or 'all'
config.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable, or 'all'. Toolsets: releases, store_listing, monetization, commerce, reviews, users, devices, advanced, vitals, reports, workflows.

config.label: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only actions
config.description: Set to 'true' to expose only read-only actions.
